mapper.insert: INSERT INTO integrated_payment ( store_id, integratedpayment_leader_id, integratedpayment_amount, integratedpayment_people, integratedpayment_status ) VALUES ( #{storeId}, #{integratedpaymentLeaderId}, #{integratedpaymentAmount}, #{integratedpaymentPeople}, #{integratedpaymentStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM integrated_payment WHERE integratedpayment_leader_id = #{leaderId} ORDER BY integratedpayment_created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM integrated_payment WHERE integratedpayment_leader_id = #{leaderId} AND integratedpayment_status = 'pending' -- ORDER BY integratedpayment_created_at DESC -- LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE integrated_payment SET integratedpayment_status = #{status}, integratedpayment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE integratedpayment_id = #{integratedPaymentId}

UPDATE integrated_payment SET integratedpayment_status = 'cancelled', integratedpayment_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE integratedpayment_status = 'pending' AND integratedpayment_created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM integrated_payment WHERE integratedpayment_status = 'pending' AND integratedpayment_created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) ORDER BY integratedpayment_created_at ASC

SELECT * FROM integrated_payment WHERE integratedpayment_status = 'pending' AND integratedpayment_created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY integratedpayment_created_at ASC
